releaseNotes: KabirUI 3.0: Full 3D visual overhaul, 10 clock & battery styles, glassmorphic folders, live search, Adaptive Home, Free placement, and Home Modes.

changes.title: Major 3.0 Release
changes.detail: KabirUI 3.0 brings a complete UI overhaul, full-screen polish, glassmorphic folders, and fluid animations.

changes.title: 10 Clock & Battery Styles
changes.detail: All 10 handcrafted clock styles and 10 battery meters are restored with height-aware geometry and zero text clipping.

changes.title: Interactive App Drawer
changes.detail: Browse swipeable categories, jump A–Z with a floating preview bubble, search apps, and organize your drawer with custom categories and optional usage shelves.

changes.title: Live Settings Search
changes.detail: Find any customization option instantly with real-time settings filtering and high contrast support.

changes.title: Glassmorphic Folders & Quick Dock
changes.detail: Redesigned folder surfaces with live app filtering and interactive dock slot editing.

changes.title: Adaptive Home
changes.detail: Get local, time-aware app suggestions and supported shortcuts on your home screen, with a clear reason for each pick.

changes.title: Free placement
changes.detail: Place apps and widgets anywhere on your home screen with grid-free dragging.

changes.title: Home Modes
changes.detail: Save separate home setups and switch manually or on an automatic weekly schedule.

changes.title: Backup & transfer
changes.detail: Save Home Modes, layouts, wallpapers, custom icons and selected settings to a single file to move to another device.
